task: Phase 2d plan Task 1 -- the field's own iteration count, and the l lever's sign
why_this_is_a_measurement_and_not_a_test: Both readings need real fits over the benchmark geometry at production or
near-production record length, which is tens of minutes. E7 already settles the shape:
2d's measurements are a benchmark, not a test, and the exit-criteria suite asserts
against the COMMITTED ARTIFACT. (a2d)'s artifact register is what makes that sound --
the artifact carries its instrument block and the check fails when a named default moves.

instrument.field: metamer.bench.fields, 32 x 12, boundary at index 16, step w = 0
instrument.host_quiet_check: gates, on load average < physical_cores - 1; stall recorded, not a gate (open question 19)

readings.name: iterations per point, per rung, at N = 630 -- exit criterion 17
method: A systematic subgrid, every 2nd point on each axis: 16 x 6 = 96 of 384, which covers
both regimes evenly and includes every coarse index. Fitted through core.fit rather
than through a full run, because THE ITERATION COUNT IS A PROPERTY OF THE SERIES AND
THE CANDIDATE SET, NOT OF THE TRAVERSAL -- Task 0 measured the whole non-fit cost of a
run at under 1%. This is a SAMPLE and is reported as one, with its spread.
prediction: Iterations per point lands between the two fixtures already measured: 25.3 (Task 0's
smooth batch) and 40.4 (2c's). The field is matern12 + white like Task 0's, but it
carries a real model-selection question, which costs iterations.

refuted_from_below.when: iterations per point < 25.3 on both rungs
reading: The field is EASIER than a plain smooth batch despite carrying more structure. The
budget is comfortable, and the same fact raises the concern the slow test
test_both_candidates_win_somewhere_on_the_field exists for: a field that converges
instantly may not be leaving a selection question to answer.

refuted_from_above.when: iterations per point > 55 on the more expensive rung
reading: THE BUDGET CROSSES THE 30 h CEILING. Under Task 0's cost model, per point per arm
is 2.43 + 0.3236 x iterations; at 55 that is 20.23 s, and 20.23 x 384 x 14.047 =
30.3 h. THE PRE-DECIDED CUT FIRES: N1 drops to one rung, factor 13.047, giving
28.2 h. The cut is taken as already decided rather than under time pressure.

how_the_budget_uses_it: The LARGER of the two rungs' counts, never the mean and never the convenient one.
A budget built on the cheaper rung is a budget that overruns on the other.

readings.name: the coherence lever's sign, isolated from the contrast
method: TWO FIELDS DIFFERING IN `l` ONLY, with `contrast` held at the easy rung's value. The
shipped rungs move BOTH levers together (E5's accepted confound), so comparing them
would measure the composite dial and not `l`. The plan's test asks about `l`, so `l`
is what varies. Each field is run cold and through run_two_pass at N = 96, and the
saving is the iteration reduction of pass 2 against its own cold reference.
N = 96 is where the 2c spike measured a real positive saving of +7.80%.
prediction: saving(long l) > saving(short l), and saving(long l) > 0. A SIGN AND AN ORDERING,
never a magnitude: N = 96 measures a different number from N = 630 rather than a
weaker one, which is obstacle 3 of criterion 12's reduced scope.
no_noise_clause_is_needed_and_here_is_wh: `fit` has no stochastic component -- D7's own reason a cold-versus-cold arm cannot
exist -- so iteration counts are DETERMINISTIC and the comparison is exact. Task 0
measured the same fixture returning 405 iterations in every one of five repeats.
This is the property that let reading 2 of Task 0 survive four instrument defects.

reading: THE LEVER IS A LABEL. E6's first prediction -- the saving rises monotonically with
`l` -- is dead before the sweep runs, and Task 1's rung design has to change rather
than the sweep's. This is the premise the whole of 2d rests on.
The warm arm is reading its own answer back: the source map is handing points their
own optimum. A source-map defect that would otherwise look like a spectacular
result -- the sharpest of E6's six clauses.

void_when.when: either field's pass 2 reports zero warm-started cells
reading: The mechanism did not run, so the saving is a measurement of the store round-trip.
(a2c) at the whole mechanism, which criterion 12's positive control already catches

sourced and the obvious proxy is contradicted by 2c's ceiling arm.
Anything about real altimetry. The standing limitation is unchanged.
